sections.title: Sound of letter cé
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (cé) /tseː/. Its main sound is heard in the word (cica) /ˈtsi.tsɒ/, which means kitten, kitty. This letter has two sounds.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: First, touch the ridge behind your upper teeth with the tip of your tongue. Stop the air, then release it into a quick hiss. Keep your voice off so your throat does not shake. Next, make the exact same movement, but turn your voice on. Touch your throat to feel it buzz.

sections.title: Reading letter cé
paragraphs: In most places, this letter is voiceless, meaning your throat does not shake. You hear it at the start of (cica) /ˈtsi.tsɒ/, and at the end of (arc) /ɒrts/. It becomes voiced before certain consonants like b through assimilation, which means one sound matches the next. You hear this voiced sound in (lécből) /ˈleːdzbøːl/.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid
paragraphs: Do not read this letter like the k in cat or the s in sun. Instead, say it like the ts sound in cats. At the start of a word, do not drop the t part. Start with a firm stop, like in cats.
